chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who began the salat (prayer) and forgot to say the takbir until he had commenced the salat (prayer). He said: He repeats the salat (prayer).

key_terms.افْتَتَحَ: he commenced or entered into the prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the ritual salat (prayer) being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he must repeat or perform again
key_terms.يُكَبِّرَ: to pronounce the takbir, here meaning the opening takbir of prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets the opening takbir in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets the opening takbir of salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rules that such a person must repeat the salat (prayer), showing the importance of Takbirat al-Iftitah in the validity of the prayer.
